warnings.message: npm: allowScripts takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: npm: min-release-age=14 in .npmrc (line 3) waits 2 weeks, longer than cooldown.minimum "3d" in depcurfew.json; depcurfew apply comments it out and writes min-release-age=3 in its managed block, so npm waits only 3 days
warnings.fix: To keep the longer delay, set cooldown.minimum to "14d" in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply again

warnings.message: Renovate: minimumReleaseAge: "10 days" in renovate.json (line 4) waits 10 days, longer than cooldown.minimum "3d" in depcurfew.json; depcurfew apply replaces it with "3 days", so Renovate waits only 3 days
warnings.fix: To keep the longer delay, set cooldown.minimum to "10d" in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply again; if an earlier depcurfew apply wrote this value to renovate.json and you lowered cooldown.minimum on purpose, nothing to do

warnings.message: Dependabot: default-days: 7 in .github/dependabot.yml (line 8) waits 1 week for npm updates, longer than cooldown.minimum "3d" in depcurfew.json; depcurfew apply replaces it with 3, so Dependabot waits only 3 days
warnings.fix: To keep the longer delay, set cooldown.minimum to "7d" in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply again
